title: EEG: Visual Working Memory + Cabergoline Challenge
description: EEG recordings from a double-blind, placebo-controlled pharmacological study in which healthy participants performed a visual working memory task after receiving the dopamine D2 agonist cabergoline (1.25 mg). Each of 27 participants completed two sessions, one with drug and one with placebo. The EEG data have not been previously published, while the behavioral data appeared in an earlier paper.
methods_description: Thirty healthy participants (27 after 3 dropouts) took part in a double-blind, two-session drug study with cabergoline 1.25 mg. Session order was counterbalanced and recorded in the Sess1_Drug column. The visual working memory task was programmed in Matlab. Data were collected around 2012-2013 at the Laboratory for Neural Computation & Cognition at Brown University. Additional metadata, including operation span (OSpan), are in a spreadsheet in the code folder.
